player_prompt.intro:
Ka kite koe i nga uara {N} ngaro i runga i te whakaaetanga.
Ki te takaro, tuhituhi [accept] ki te kohi i te uara *tukutuku*, ki [continue] ranei ki te mahue i a ia, ka kite i te uara ke.
Ki te kore koe e whakaae, ka kaha koe ki te tango i te uara whakamutunga.
Ka win koe (utu = 1) **inoa** ki te uara koe i whiriwhiri ko te uara teitei rawa o te katoa.

game_action.current_value: Ko te uara o nāianei ko {value}.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Me whakaputa te mahi ki te tuhituhi rite, me [accept], me [continue] ranei.

outcome.summary: You accepted value {value} at draw {draw_num}/{N}. The best overall was {best}. {result}
outcome.not_max: Ehara i te mea nui rawa.
